About Us

A church family growing together in faith, hope and love.

Who We Are

Willow Grove Seventh-day Adventist Church is a community of believers in Willow Grove, Pennsylvania, devoted to following Jesus, sharing His love, and serving our neighbors.

We gather every Sabbath to worship, to study God’s Word, and to encourage one another — and everyone is welcome.

Plan Your Visit

What We Believe

We are part of the worldwide Seventh-day Adventist Church and hold the fundamental beliefs of the Adventist faith — grounded in Scripture, centered on Jesus, and lived out in everyday life.

Explore Our Beliefs

Our History

For decades, God has been faithful to this church and our community. Our full story is being gathered — founding year, milestones, and the people who shaped Willow Grove SDA Church.

Our Leadership

Fundamental beliefs

28 Beliefs, in brief

01

Holy Scriptures

The Bible is God’s inspired Word and the standard for faith and life.

02

Trinity

One God: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

03

God the Father

Creator, source, and sustainer of all, full of love and justice.

04

God the Son

Jesus Christ is truly God and truly human, our Savior and Lord.

05

God the Holy Spirit

Active in creation, inspiration, and in drawing us to Jesus.

06

Creation

God created the world in a recent six-day creation and rested on the seventh.

07

Nature of Humanity

Made in God’s image, free, and designed for relationship.

08

Great Controversy

All of history is part of a cosmic conflict between good and evil.

09

Life, Death & Resurrection of Christ

Jesus’ life, death, and resurrection provide the only way to salvation.

10

Experience of Salvation

By grace through faith, we are made new in Christ.

11

Growing in Christ

Daily walking with Jesus transforms our lives.

12

The Church

A community of believers who confess Jesus as Lord and Savior.

13

Remnant & Its Mission

A global movement called to share the everlasting gospel.

14

Unity in the Body of Christ

One body, many people — every nation, culture, and background.

15

Baptism

A public sign of faith, new life, and belonging.

16

Lord’s Supper

Communion renews our connection to Christ and each other.

17

Spiritual Gifts & Ministries

God gives every member gifts to serve others.

18

Gift of Prophecy

Ellen G. White’s ministry is viewed as a continuing prophetic gift.

19

Law of God

The Ten Commandments reveal God’s love and will.

20

The Sabbath

A weekly gift of rest and worship from Friday to Saturday sunset.

21

Stewardship

We’re caretakers of time, talents, and resources.

22

Christian Behavior

A life shaped by purity, health, and wise choices.

23

Marriage & Family

A lifelong, loving union and the foundation of family.

24

Christ’s Ministry in the Sanctuary

Jesus ministers on our behalf in heaven.

25

Second Coming

Christ will return personally and visibly.

26

Death & Resurrection

Death is a sleep until the resurrection at Christ’s return.

27

Millennium & End of Sin

A thousand years of peace, then the final end of evil.

28

New Earth

God will make all things new — no more pain or tears.
